name: ToolbarInput
description: Text input inside the toolbar, sized by the `size` of `Toolbar.Root`. Renders an `<input>` element.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Value shown in the input when it first renders. Use when the input is not controlled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called each time the input value changes, such as on every keystroke. Receives the new value.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: focusableWhenDisabled
props.description: When `true` the item remains focusable when disabled.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Toolbar.Input.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
